author: Crazy_
body:
We've been getting biweekly update posts and development weekly updates for the last few weeks now, but it's hard to know what the Sr team has been up to.

Since I'm curious, I'm hoping someone can tell me what the Sr team is up to these days and what are you guys are working on that you can share with the public? 

Thanks :)

title: What have you guys been up to?

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Micah, Kyoal, and Tyler have been working on new appeal requirements.

Passively has been working on translations, and fixing maps.

I have been working on biweekly updates.

As a team, we have created punishment guidelines for mutes, and have also performed general duties such as dealing with appeals and making other types of decisions.

This isn't all that we have done; it is simply a list of the things that make the most impact.
